name: code-mode
description: Code Mode for Claude Code: the model writes a small sandboxed CEL program that calls MCP and read-only tools, filters and joins their results, and returns only what it needs, so large tool outputs never fill the context. Every call still goes through the permission checks.

tools.title: Callable tools
tools.description: A regex over full tool names: the tools a program may call. Empty means the default, every MCP tool plus Read, Glob, Grep, WebFetch and WebSearch. code-mode's own tools are never callable.

always_allow.title: Tools programs may call without asking
always_allow.description: A regex over full tool names. A program's call to a matching tool runs without the approval dialog even when your permission rules would ask about it. Empty (the default) means none: every such call needs your approval, given once per program before it runs.

deny_direct.title: Route MCP calls through programs
deny_direct.description: Deny Claude's direct calls to callable MCP tools and point it to the run tool. Calls a program makes still pass.

max_calls.title: Tool calls per program
max_calls.description: A program making more tool calls than this is stopped.

concurrency.title: Parallel calls
concurrency.description: How many calls callEach runs at once.

max_output.title: Result size
max_output.description: Characters of a program's result that Claude reads; the rest is cut with a note.

max_vars.title: Kept vars
max_vars.description: How many `var` values programs may keep in memory for the session at once; `var name = null` frees one. 0 turns `var` off.
